visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A woman in a white cardigan and purple top holds a smartphone, filming herself and a group of individuals in yellow and blue cheerleader uniforms. Two figures in the background appear to be men wearing long black wigs and hair clips; they look at the camera with exaggerated, playful expressions while adjusting their hair. (2) The scene shifts to an indoor room where the woman points specifically at the bangs of one of the wig-wearing individuals. The person in the wig touches their hair nervously as the woman leans in close to inspect the strands, pointing out specific sections. A second man in a school uniform stands behind them, looking confused. (3) In a brightly lit dressing area, the woman continues her 'bangs inspection.' One individual in a wig attempts to place a large purple hair roller on their forehead while looking into a mirror. The woman films this, laughing, as the person struggles to secure the roller. (4) The woman moves to another room where a different man in a long wig is adjusting his hair near a mirror. She reaches out to touch his hair, and he playfully swats her hand away, expressing annoyance. The background shows clothing racks and a cluttered studio environment. (5) Back in a dressing room setting, two individuals in cheerleader wigs are using makeup powder puffs. One holds a pink 'piuu' brand puff. The woman critiques their oily-looking bangs, pointing at the separate strands of hair while they defend their look as 'moisturized' rather than oily. The video ends with a series of quick cuts and laughter.
